review.tagline: LoRA and LoKr training suite for image, video and audio diffusion models
review.summary: AI Toolkit trains LoRA and LoKr adapters for diffusion models, driven by YAML configs through `python run.py` or a web UI on port 8675. It covers image, instruction/edit, video and audio models, including FLUX.1/2, Qwen-Image, Z-Image, Wan 2.1/2.2, LTX-2 and Ace Step. It targets consumer Nvidia GPUs and has setup notes for RunPod and Modal.
review.audience: People fine-tuning LoRAs for diffusion models on their own Nvidia GPU
strengths: Supports many recent models: FLUX.2, Qwen-Image, Wan 2.2, LTX-2, Ace Step
Same jobs run from the CLI with YAML configs or from the web UI
Layer targeting with only_if_contains and ignore_if_contains; LoKr supported
Bucketing resizes images automatically, so no manual cropping is needed
weaknesses: Manual install requires an Nvidia GPU; Apple Silicon support is marked experimental
AI Toolkit Manager installer is labelled experimental
Datasets limited to jpg, jpeg and png; webp has issues
Ctrl+C during a checkpoint save will likely corrupt that checkpoint
needs: Needs PyTorch, Node.js >20 (UI), Hugging Face model weights, git
Models: FLUX.1, FLUX.2, Qwen-Image, Z-Image, SDXL
